title: TS2Python wire v1 — tick
description: Payload emitted by EL_PublishTick. Frame 2 of a 2-frame ZMQ message; frame 1 is the UTF-8 symbol topic. See envelope.md and semantics.md — schema validation alone is NOT sufficient to implement a correct binding.

ts.description: DLL receive-side wall clock, UTC epoch seconds with sub-second precision. AUTHORITATIVE for tick event time. Must NOT be used for bar bucket alignment.

ts_utc.description: ts_str converted to UTC epoch by the DLL via std::chrono::zoned_time("America/New_York"). 0.0 when el_timestamp was absent or unparseable. Cross-check only — never authoritative.

ts_str.description: Raw EL timestamp, format yyyy-MM/dd-HH:mm:ss (24-hour), passed through verbatim. Empty string when EL supplied none. NOT JSON-escaped by the publisher.

vol.description: Volume. Emitted as a double (%.6f) even though semantically integral. Meaningless for index/breadth symbols.

bid.description: Bid. ALWAYS a number on the wire — never null. Bindings MUST treat this as invalid for the index/breadth symbols listed in semantics.md §3.

tc.description: Tick count. Emitted as %.0f — integral value in a double field.
